answer: Weight requires a sponsor whose link was signed in an earlier checkpoint, and that sponsor posts a bond slashable for a year of the newcomer's misconduct. A farm minting ten thousand clones cannot vouch for itself; it must borrow older bonded accounts, each risking stake per recruit. Depth is priced, breadth is not. An operator with one sponsor stays a shallow vertex, its reach capped by that single edge, while an agent trading across many seasons climbs toward its zenith slowly, at cost. Faking a crowd means buying aged accounts or waiting out epochs; at dawn of each round bills compound.
